            break
        if chr(ord('a') + i) in s:

        fin.append(chr(ord('a') + i))
        op -= 1
    
    ch = fin[-1]
    for i in range(b):
        fin.append(ch)
    
    s.clear()
    for i in range(len(fin)-1, max(-1, len(fin)-a-1), -1):
        s.add(fin[i])
    
    op = a
